activation_gate.decision: Do not install, fit, cluster, screen, promote, or compare the spatial transcript-native baseline suite in v1.
activation_gate.minimum_future_evidence: A rights-cleared powered participant-level spatial RNA source with authoritative counts, coordinates, participant and section joins, a registered endpoint, and a genuinely external source.
activation_gate.task_gate: If any spatial model activates, this suite activates as a mandatory comparator under the same assay, resolution, donor folds, transductive or frozen lane, and endpoint.

lane_definitions.expression_only: RNA-only normalization, development-frozen HVGs and PCA, then an endpoint-matched linear classifier or explicitly target-transductive K-means or Leiden.
lane_definitions.simple_spatial_neighbor: The same RNA features augmented with row-normalized neighbor means from a participant- and section-local locked coordinate graph, with lambda selected on development participants.
lane_definitions.BayesSpace: Original-spot spatial clustering without H&E for spot-based platforms only. Subspot enhancement is diagnostic at most and excluded from the primary endpoint.
lane_definitions.purpose: Measure whether a complex spatial model adds transferable signal beyond expression alone, a simple local-neighborhood transform, and a spot-native spatial model.

gse192741.biological_units: 4 donors represented by 5 Visium sections; one donor contributes 2 sections
gse192741.why: Four donors, exposed outcomes, and unresolved hg19 annotation identity preclude model superiority. The dataset may only support future plumbing fixtures.

gse292268.biological_units: 4 F2 MASLD donors distributed two per CosMx slide
gse292268.why: The slide, field-of-view, and region-to-donor mapping is unresolved and four donors cannot support donor-level evaluation.

hra007511.why: Spatial matrices, coordinates, joins, and reuse rights are not admitted. H&E and adjacent-section MALDI are excluded from these transcript-native lanes.

vu2025.biological_units: 33 biopsies from 32 participants distributed across 10 VLP technical arrays
vu2025.why: A data-sharing agreement and barcode-to-biopsy participant map are required. No graph or BayesSpace lattice may span the four to five participants sharing one array.

donor_and_topology_firewall.graphs: Build graph and lattice objects within authoritative participant and section or core boundaries. Combine block-diagonally; keep all sections from one participant in one fold.
donor_and_topology_firewall.vu2025: A technical array is not a donor. Split barcodes and tissue islands by biopsy and participant before any neighbor relation.
donor_and_topology_firewall.replication: Participants are replicates. Cells, spots, modeled subspots, nodes, edges, arrays, sections, clusters, and posterior samples are not.
donor_and_topology_firewall.pairing: Same-study or adjacent-section assays cannot be converted into same-cell, same-spot, or same-section observations.

fit_and_selection_firewall.strict_lane: Fit feature selection, transferable scaling, PCA, supervised head, calibration, thresholds, lambda, graph hyperparameters, and all tuning on development participants. Process each held participant independently under the locked recipe.
fit_and_selection_firewall.transductive_lane: Target-fitted PCA, clustering, BayesSpace inference, or cross-sample correction is allowed only for a prespecified cohort-partition task and must be reported as transductive.
fit_and_selection_firewall.held_labels: Never use held annotations or outcomes to select HVGs, PCA, K or radius, lambda, graph, cluster algorithm, resolution, q, BayesSpace parameters, initialization, exclusions, or label mapping.
fit_and_selection_firewall.BayesSpace: Score at original-spot and participant levels. Modeled subspots remain derivable_not_observed and cannot increase n.
fit_and_selection_firewall.missingness: Preserve explicit assay and join states; do not convert absent panel genes, filtered observations, permission blocks, or failed joins to biological zeros.

training_and_exposure_crosswalk.future_exposure_rule: A fitted state is outcome-unexposed only when every learned transform, spatial graph choice, hyperparameter, head, cluster mapping, and calibration is selected without held outcomes and within the registered lane.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_future_gate_passes: An endpoint-matched transcript-native baseline may be the winning released model when it passes its own external gate.
claim_boundary.prohibited_now: Any v1 spatial result, superiority statement, MASLD spatial champion, or claim that smoothed or modeled subspot expression is independent measured biology.
claim_boundary.clinical: No diagnostic, prognostic, treatment-response, or deployment claim.

interpretation: These are the required reality-check baselines for any future spatial track. They test expression alone, a simple local-neighborhood augmentation, and a spot-native Bayesian spatial method without pretrained representations or histology. Their simplicity does not exempt them from donor leakage, transductive labeling, assay-native assumptions, or rights and power gates. No eligible spatial task or source exists now, so the suite remains deferred.
